notes:
Summary:
- Mid-size enterprise within clinical research (EU HQ) evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for production inference handling PHI. Very security- and residency-sensitive.
- Primary ask: private VPC deployment with BYOK KMS, audit logging shipped to customer SIEM/S3, and regionally restricted data residency (EU-only initially).

Recent timeline:
- 2026-01-18: Intro call (AE Jordan P.). High-level requirements captured. Asked for security questionnaire.
- 2026-02-02: Security questionnaire submitted (see drive link). Security team flagged KMS and audit log retention questions.
- 2026-02-14: Deep-dive with infra + security (Fireflies ff-20260214-0312). Discussed VPC topology and outbound allowlist model.
- 2026-02-28: Demo of Redwood Private (short walkthrough). Confirmed control-plane options (hosted vs private control plane).
- 2026-03-01: SE technical review with Ravi (ff-20260301-1105). Walked through KMS BYOK flow and CloudHSM options.
- 2026-03-05: Network team requested explicit CIDR/egress diagram and sample Security Groups for review.

Architecture fit notes (initial qualification):
- Preferred region: eu-west-1 (primary). Secondary/DR: eu-central-1; NA region holdings later but must be opt-in.
- VPC topology: 3 AZ private subnets for inference nodes; dedicated management subnet for control-plane gateways. No public IPs on inference instances. Bastion/management access only via SSO-backed jump host + customer VPN.
- Inbound/Outbound: No inbound internet access to inference nodes. Outbound restricted via NAT/gateway with strict allowlist to Redwood control endpoints (if using hosted control-plane) or via private peering/VPN for private control-plane. Require explicit egress ACLs and flow logs.
- Service endpoints: Prefer VPC endpoints for S3, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch. All artifact pulls (model blobs, containers) must come from S3 in same region or from customer-provided repository.
- KMS integration: BYOK via AWS KMS with key policies and CMK rotation; optional CloudHSM for key escrow if required by compliance. Must support envelope encryption for tokens and model cache.
- Audit logging: All inference request metadata & system logs forwarded to customer's SIEM (CloudWatch -> Kinesis -> S3 + auto-archive). Retention requirement: 7 years for audit trail.
- Data residency: EU-only processing and storage for PHI/PII datasets. Egress controls to prevent cross-region replication unless explicitly approved.

POC / Success criteria:
- 2-week POC in eu-west-1 using sample EHR dataset (synthetic).
- Performance: p50 latency < 80ms, p99 < 350ms for 512-token context at target throughput 8 RPS per instance for chat flows; embeddings throughput 400 reqs/s in burst.
- Security: KMS BYOK proof, audit logs forwarded to customer SIEM, SSO/SAML login tested.
- Ops: ability to pin model versions and perform a canary rollback without data leakage.

Notes from security: (shorthand)
- "Need DPA + SCCs or equivalent. SOC2 report and ISO attestation required."
- "Retention controls: must be able to purge caches on request; show retention workflow."
- "Require network diagram showing exact egress CIDRs used by Redwood control-plane or option to avoid outbound entirely via private control-plane."

Open questions / blockers: 
- Legal: DPA language negotiation outstanding.
- Network: infra needs explicit CIDR + SG examples for approval.
- Security: Customer wants CloudHSM option and proof of key custody flows.
- Procurement: CFO sign-off targeted Q2 budget cycle.

Next steps (short):
- Deliver VPC topology diagram (requested 2026-03-06).
- Provide KMS BYOK runbook + CloudHSM options doc.
- Schedule network review w/ Montclair infra team (target week of 2026-03-08).
- Begin 2-week POC after network signoff; coordinate with Ravi for test plan and eval metrics.

Stated customer quote (paraphrase): "Main priority is airtight data residency and auditable key management — performance is secondary but must be predictable for 24/7 support workflows."

CRM entry tone: short bullets, actionable, many references to drive/docs/tickets. Follow up priority: high.
